keyResults.statement: Third-order helicity of a volume-preserving field on invariant unlinked domains, realised as an average asymptotic mu-bar-123 of orbits, with an L^2-energy lower bound whose constant is geometric.
keyResults.useForFolio: The Borromean third-order invariant is the natural many-body object for the Borromean-link blocks; the registry note already extracted the two negatives (total antisymmetry of mu-bar-123, and Flux^3 rather than Flux^2 scaling) that constrain a Coulomb-like pair-energy ansatz.
